crossRefs.note: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

translations.web: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
translations.bsb: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.
translations.kjv: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth:
translations.asv: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
